description: Session layer: seed and id derivation, ChaCha20-Poly1305 with the wire format seq(8, big-endian) || nonce(12) || ciphertext, AAD = seq || caller AAD, 1024-entry replay window, key rotation every RekeyInterval messages (HKDF info "sage-session-rekey-v1" || direction || be64(generation)). Nonces are random, so ciphertext vectors are verify-only: the check decrypts them with a fresh session built from the same seed.

vectors.name: seed-and-id
vectors.description: seed = HKDF-Extract(SHA-256, sharedSecret, salt = SHA256(label || ctx || lo || hi)) with (lo, hi) the byte-sorted ephemeral keys; id = base64url-raw(SHA256(label || seed)[:16]).

vectors.name: encrypt-decrypt
vectors.description: Encrypt/Decrypt with the shared (non-directional) key at seq 0 and, after 256 messages, at seq 256 (generation 1, rotated key). The check builds a receiver from the same seed and id and decrypts both records in order.

vectors.name: directional-with-aad
vectors.description: EncryptOutbound/DecryptInbound with directional keys (initiator sends on c2s) and EncryptWithAAD/DecryptWithAAD binding caller AAD after the seq header.
